blocks.html: June 2026, Manila — Robinsons Hotels and Resorts (RHR) has partnered with Duty Free Philippines (DFP) to extend exclusive hotel privileges to members of the DFP loyalty program, strengthening access to accommodations in RHR’s growing nationwide portfolio.

“At Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, we continuously seek meaningful partnerships that support the growth of tourism while enabling us to offer more targeted value, including special perks for Duty Free Philippines loyalty members,” explains Senior Vice-President and Business Unit General Manager Barun Jolly. “This collaboration also allows us to introduce more travelers to our diverse portfolio of brands and destinations, helping them discover accommodations that best suit their needs,” he continues.
By linking DFP’s loyalty program with RHR’s network of hotels, the partnership offers members added flexibility and value in how they plan and enjoy their travels.

DFP’s Chief Operating Officer Joel M. Cinco says, “This alliance strengthens our loyalty program by expanding the range of exclusive perks available to our Balikbayan Plus Cardholders and Premier Club Cardholders -- specifically, access to special rates at participating properties of Robinsons Hotels and Resorts. By extending these benefits into the hospitality space, we are able to offer greater value and flexibility—enhancing how our members plan and experience their journeys.”

DFP loyalty members can enjoy discounts at RHR’s homegrown brands Grand Summit Hotels, Summit Hotels and Resorts, Go Hotels and Go Hotels Plus, as well as its international partners, Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria and Holiday Inn Manila Galleria.

blocks.html: Robinsons Hotels and Resorts (RHR) is the Philippines' largest and most geographically diverse hospitality group, with 30 properties across 20 cities and municipalities nation-wide. Its versatile portfolio consists of 10 brands, ranging from ultra-luxury to essential value.

The collection features Fili Hotels, the first Filipino-owned five-star hotel brand, and NUSTAR Hotel Cebu, alongside international partners such as The Westin Manila, Crowne Plaza Galleria Manila, Holiday Inn Galleria Manila, and Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu.

Completing its nationwide reach are its homegrown brands -- the upscale Grand Summit Hotels, the midscale Summit Hotels and Resorts, and the essential-service pioneers Go Hotels and Go Hotels Plus. Whether for business or leisure, RHR provides world-class service rooted in local expertise.
